title: Kanan Jarrus
description: Caleb Dume was on the planet Kaller with Jedi Master Depa Billaba when Chancellor Palpatine declared the Jedi enemies of the Republic. On the run for his life, Caleb left his life as a Jedi behind, adopted the name of Kanan Jarrus, and joined a small group of rebels led by Hera Syndulla. Alongside their little band of found family, they fought against the Empire. Taking Ezra Bridger as his Padawan, he learned to once again embrace the ways of the Jedi. He sacrificed his life to save his rebel family, and his legacy lived on in the form of his son, young Jacen Syndulla.
